hooks.text: "Some of them have eyes like forge coals and the rest follow them. Put the bright ones down. The Watch pays by the head, when it pays."
"There's always one out in front, shouting orders nobody's given for three hundred years. Shut it up for me."
"Bounty, posted and paid: the big ones that lead the walking dead. Proof is you coming back."
"The ones that burn brightest carry the most of the Ember. Put them out gently, if you can. You can't."
"A big one stood in the road at dusk and saluted the cart. The horse hasn't been right since."
"The big ones wear real legion steel, and we'd like to know it can be cut. Find out. The daughter."

brief.one: Defeat an elite (a bright-eyed one) in the Old Barrows
brief.many: Defeat {n} elites (bright-eyed ones) in the Old Barrows

label: Elites defeated in the Old Barrows
journal: Defeat {n} of the bright-eyed ones in the Old Barrows. Hold a room until one comes to lead the rest (about every fifth wave).
ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule in Thornwick.
done: Fewer of the dead in the barrows march in step.

hooks.text: "The worst of what's in {site} comes out every so often to see who's about. Be about. Put it down."
"There's a big one in {site}. There's always a big one. This time, somebody kill it."
"I'm told the brutes in {site} carry better than the rest. I'm told this by people who never came back. Go and see."
"Some of what walks in {site} leads the rest. Take away the leaders, and the rest may lie down."
"Bring us a story about one of the big ones in {site}. A true one. The coin's for the truth."
"Something in {site} took a pole out of my hands last week. It was a good pole. Avenge it."

brief.one: Put down one of the elites in {site}

fens.label: Elites put down in {site}
fens.journal: Go into {site} and put down {n} of the elites that come with every fifth wave.
fens.ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
fens.done: Something big stopped walking about in the reeds.
